# CB 1: Dismantle Overmighty Hegemony (均势拆霸战争 — icon: icons/casus_belli/oe_heg2_cb_dismantle_hegemony.dds)
oe_heg2_cb_dismantle_hegemony = {
	speed = 15
	cut_down_in_size_cb = yes
	war_goal_type = take_capital_imperial

	create_visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		is_great_power = yes
		is_hegemon = no
		scope:target = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			OR = {
				oe_heg2_is_multi_hegemon = yes
				oe_heg2_has_any_tier2_plus = yes
			}
		}
	}

	create_enabled = {
		is_great_power = yes
		is_hegemon = no
		NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:target }
		NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
			OR = {
				oe_heg2_is_multi_hegemon = yes
				oe_heg2_has_any_tier2_plus = yes
			}
		}
	}

	declare_enabled = {
		is_hegemon = no
		scope:target = {
			OR = {
				oe_heg2_is_multi_hegemon = yes
				oe_heg2_has_any_tier2_plus = yes
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "BASE"
			value = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
			add = {
				desc = "DIPLO_ALLIED"
				value = -100
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { oe_heg2_tension_high = yes }
			add = {
				desc = "OE_HEG2_CB_TENSION_REASON"
				value = 40
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:target = { oe_heg2_is_multi_hegemon = yes } }
			add = {
				desc = "OE_HEG2_CB_MULTI_HEG_REASON"
				value = 35
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target = {
					has_variable = oe_ent_index
					var:oe_ent_index >= 60
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_HEG2_CB_ENTROPY_REASON"
				value = 25
			}
		}
	}
}

# CB 2: Free Seas & Break Maritime Monopoly (公海自由航行战争 — Naval/Commercial anti-hegemon CB)
oe_heg2_cb_free_seas_charter = {
	trade = yes
	speed = 18
	war_goal_type = naval

	create_visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		has_ports = yes
		NOT = { is_hegemon_type = hegemony:naval_hegemon }
		scope:target = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_hegemon_type = hegemony:naval_hegemon
		}
	}

	create_enabled = {
		has_ports = yes
		navy_size > 0
		NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:target }
		NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
			is_hegemon_type = hegemony:naval_hegemon
		}
	}

	declare_enabled = {
		has_ports = yes
		scope:target = {
			is_hegemon_type = hegemony:naval_hegemon
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "BASE"
			value = -30
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
			add = {
				desc = "DIPLO_ALLIED"
				value = -100
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_modifier = oe_heg2_maritime_search_tribute_mod
					scope:target = { is_embargoing = root }
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_HEG2_CB_SEA_MONOPOLY_REASON"
				value = 45
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				navy_size >= {
					value = scope:target.navy_size
					multiply = 0.85
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_HEG2_CB_FLEET_PARITY_REASON"
				value = 35
			}
		}
	}
}
